box_convention: Visible person extent only, clipped to image/crop; do not invent hidden body extent.
occlusion: Every visible person must be boxed. If presence or extent cannot be resolved, exclude the image/crop. No arbitrary ignore region or ignore class.
minimum_visibility: No numerical cutoff is assumed: include each identifiable visible person; unresolved cases exclude scope.
crop_policy: Review all visible context, including outside ROI; confirm truncated persons at every crop edge.
negative_policy: Explicit empty confirmation after viewing the complete image/crop is required.
